description: This file defines an Android activity 'RoundRects' which demonstrates the use of GradientDrawable to draw rounded rectangle shapes with different gradient types and corner radii. It contains an inner class 'SampleView' that handles the drawing operations on a Canvas.

classes.name: RoundRects
classes.description: An Android activity that sets up a custom view to showcase drawing gradient drawables with various radii and gradient types.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that performs drawing operations with GradientDrawable to demonstrate rounded rectangles with different gradient types and corner radii.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: setCornerRadii
methods.description: A static helper method to set individual corner radii for the GradientDrawable.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of multiple gradient rectangles with different configurations on the Canvas.
